notes.title: Version 1.0.04 Update is Available
notes.notes:
Hello, Friendly Sheep Community!

We thank you all for your overwhelming support, which greatly exceeded our expectations! It melts our hearts to know that thousands of people have had exciting hours with our little sheep-farming game.

Here is the update notes for Friendly Sheep
with your precious feedback, and what we sprinkle on top of it:


 Added more items
[olist]
 Stone Oven
 Cheese
 Pasteurized Milk
 Abomasum
 Empty Bowl
 Bread
 Steak Sandwich
 Rennet
[/olist]
 Added new more Quests
[olist]
 Buy Stone Oven
 Amateur Baker
 Though Times II
 Pasteurized Milk
 Making Of Cheese
 Steak Sandwiches
[/olist]
 Changed some UI Elements
[olist]
 Changed Text Size on Quests information
 Changed Text Size on Item Details
 Changed Text Size on Item Information on Stations
[/olist]
 Fixed Irrigation not saving and not connecting with Plots



We also made a lot of minor fixes and optimizations.
If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
Click here to join our Discord.

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.04!

Thanks,
ACGames

notes.title: Version 1.0.02 Update is Available
notes.notes:
Hello, Friendly Sheep Community!

We thank you all for your overwhelming support, which greatly exceeded our expectations! It melts our hearts to know that thousands of people have had exciting hours with our little sheep-farming game.

Foremost, I should say that I am a solo developer, and I am very approachable 7/24 via our Discord server! We consider every suggestion/idea/feedback/criticism and are working hard to implement them to make Friendly Sheep the best game about Sheep in the world!

https://i.ibb.co/9hwrj8k/gif2.gif

https://i.ibb.co/n7MNbBd/gif3.gif

Here is the first after-launch update notes for Friendly Sheep
with your precious feedback, and what we sprinkle on top of it:


 Add Mouse Sensitivity settings to options.
 Add Option to increase/decrease the quantity of items to buy.
 Add Option to view all animal needs.
 Decrease the money needed for Tough Times Quest from 150 to 100.
 Several UI elements have been changed.
 Updated some screenshots on the Store Page


We also made a lot of minor fixes and optimizations.
If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
Click here to join our Discord.

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.02!

Thanks,
ACGames

notes.title: New demo version available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce an update for the demo of my game! This new version comes with tons of bug fixes, environment improvements and save system

I want to thank you all for the amazing support so far. Since I'm developing the game on my own, your feedback and recommendations are super important to me. I want to create the best cozy game possible, and your opinions really help me shape the future of the project.

Feel free to join the Discord channel to share your thoughts on this update: https://discord.gg/vS3B6j4X. I'd love to hear what you think! and you will also be able to see some of the new features on the early access game

Thanks again, and dont forget... be a friendly with your sheeps!
